svg.title: The $510,000 to $140,250 Profit Bridge
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-profit-bridge; chart type: waterfall; title: The $510,000 to $140,250 Profit Bridge; subtitle: Four illustrative expense buckets reconcile to a 27.5% net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per year. First and last bars are absolute totals; middle bars are signed expense movements. Cost allocations are illustrative, while revenue, margin, and owner net profit are canonical. Do not subtract brokerage splits again from retained revenue.; caption: $510,000 − $180,000 − $90,000 − $60,000 − $39,750 = $140,250; $140,250 / $510,000 = 27.5%. Conservative: $120,000 revenue and $24,000 profit at 20%. Scaled: $900,000 revenue and $315,000 profit at 35%.; stages: label: Retained gross revenue; value: $510,000 annual commissions after brokerage splits; numeric value: 510000.0; detail: Opening absolute total. Model 30 completed brokerage transactions averaging $17,000 retained commission; underlying home prices and estate distributions are excluded.; label: Full-time personnel; value: Subtract $180,000 for two full-time operating seats; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Illustrative loaded compensation for the broker lead and operations lead. Any owner compensation included here is an expense distinct from the residual owner net profit.; label: Contractor delivery; value: Subtract $90,000 for three contracted delivery seats; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Budget field brokerage support, transaction coordination, and vendor coordination. Include only operator-paid costs not already removed in calculating retained commissions.; label: Origination and marketing; value: Subtract $60,000 for attributable pipeline development; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Allocate docket access, relationship development, property marketing, and targeted outreach. Measure spend against collected commissions rather than unsigned pipeline estimates.; label: Operating overhead; value: Subtract $39,750 for remaining operating expenses; numeric value: -39750.0; detail: Illustrative insurance, software, accounting, licensing, travel, and administrative expense allocation. Estate-funded repairs paid directly to vendors are outside operator revenue.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $140,250 residual profit at 27.5% net margin; numeric value: 140250.0; detail: Closing absolute total, not another additive movement. Total modeled expenses are $369,750; this bridge preserves the canonical Base-Case annual owner net profit.

rect.title: label: Retained gross revenue; value: $510,000 annual commissions after brokerage splits; numeric value: 510000.0; detail: Opening absolute total. Model 30 completed brokerage transactions averaging $17,000 retained commission; underlying home prices and estate distributions are excluded.

label: Full-time personnel; value: Subtract $180,000 for two full-time operating seats; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Illustrative loaded compensation for the broker lead and operations lead. Any owner compensation included here is an expense distinct from the residual owner net profit.

label: Contractor delivery; value: Subtract $90,000 for three contracted delivery seats; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Budget field brokerage support, transaction coordination, and vendor coordination. Include only operator-paid costs not already removed in calculating retained commissions.

label: Origination and marketing; value: Subtract $60,000 for attributable pipeline development; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Allocate docket access, relationship development, property marketing, and targeted outreach. Measure spend against collected commissions rather than unsigned pipeline estimates.

label: Operating overhead; value: Subtract $39,750 for remaining operating expenses; numeric value: -39750.0; detail: Illustrative insurance, software, accounting, licensing, travel, and administrative expense allocation. Estate-funded repairs paid directly to vendors are outside operator revenue.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $140,250 residual profit at 27.5% net margin; numeric value: 140250.0; detail: Closing absolute total, not another additive movement. Total modeled expenses are $369,750; this bridge preserves the canonical Base-Case annual owner net profit.

text.title: Assumptions: USD per year. First and last bars are absolute totals; middle bars are signed expense movements. Cost allocations are illustrative, while revenue, margin, and owner net profit are canonical. Do not subtract brokerage splits again from retained revenue.
